_comment: EXTERNAL link config, used only by .github/workflows/docs-links.yml.
The sibling markdown-link-check-config.json — the one the pre-commit hook
uses on every PR — ignores '^https?://', so the merge gate validates only
relative links inside the repo. That split is deliberate: a broken relative
link is the author's own doing and deterministic, so it belongs on the gate;
a dead external URL means someone else's site moved, which is neither.
This file drops that ignore so the weekly sweep covers what the gate cannot.
The retry/timeout settings below only ever mattered for HTTP, which is why
they exist in the shared config at all.
